call_points.text: Management expects growth momentum to continue despite potential macroeconomic concerns and inflationary pressures.
EBITDA margins reached 7.5% for FY26, driven by marketing efficiencies and productivity gains.
No numeric FY27 revenue, margin or capex guidance is given in the presentation.
FY26 operating cash flow ₹644.3 Cr versus ₹466.6 Cr in FY25.

guidance.statement: Nykaa Now to be present in over 25 cities by end of FY27
Superstore to return to 35%+ CAGR trajectory by FY2030
Fashion vertical to grow 3 to 3.5x over a 4- to 5-year period

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > E-Retail/ E-Commerce

operating_notes.text: CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil A/Stable on ₹178 Cr of long-term bank facilities on 8 May 2026.
Nykaa Fashion reported a positive 0.3% EBITDA margin in Q4FY26.
Beauty average order value grew about 5% YoY; annual unique transacting customers crossed 20 million and lifetime shoppers reached about 60 million, up 33% YoY.
Retail network stood at 324 stores across 105+ cities after 11 additions in Q1FY27, with double-digit same-store sales growth and 50% of stores in Tier 2 and beyond.
House of Nykaa has 13 brands with annualised GMV of ₹3,760 Cr, up 39% YoY; Dot & Key is a ₹1,300 Cr annualised NSV brand.

timeline.summary: On 8 May 2026, CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil A/Stable on FSN E-Commerce Ventures' ₹178 Cr long-term bank facilities.

FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited’s **Dr. Chetan Sharma** and **Rajendra Sharma** announced an **Institutional Investors Day Meeting** on **June 18, 2026 (Mumbai)**, invite-only with webcast for analysts and investors.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,648.17 Cr (+28.4% YoY), net profit ₹78.75 Cr (+313.4% YoY).
On 21 May 2026, FSN E-Commerce Ventures' FY26 investor presentation showed revenue of ₹10,022 Cr (+26% YoY), EBITDA of ₹752 Cr (7.5% margin) and PAT of ₹204 Cr (+183%).
FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited shared audio/video recordings of its May 21, 2026, Analyst/Investor Conference Call on its website.
On 26 May 2026, FSN E-Commerce Ventures published the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call, highlighting a 28% YoY revenue growth.
Q1FY27 (Aug 2026): Nykaa reported revenue up 29% YoY to ₹2,782 Cr and PAT up 226% to ₹80 Cr, and announced acquisition of 51% of premium dermocosmetic brand Aminu.
